cautions.en: No public pricing tiers are disclosed on the official product page; only a free trial and a 'Buy Now' contact path are offered.

capabilities.en: 3D packaging design and visualization: creates 3D content, movies, virtual packshots and virtual shopping-shelf renders.
Print modeling technology that syncs 3D models with actual production assets for accurate packaging previews.
Dedicated shrink sleeve simulation and ray-traced photorealistic rendering, with material experimentation across substrates, inks, varnishes, foils and holograms.

limitations.en: No public pricing or self-serve purchase path; access requires a sales contact or trial request.
Requires Adobe Illustrator as the design environment (plugin-based), so it is not a standalone application.

unknowns: No pricing figures disclosed publicly; not covered within the 8-page research budget for this batch.
Supported operating systems (Windows/macOS) not explicitly stated on the product page.
